item.title: PCSO Turns Over ₱500,000 IPP Grant to Lingap Pangarap ng Mga Paslit Center
item.description: LIPA CITY, Batangas — The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over a ₱500,000 grant under the Institutional Partnership Program (IPP) to Lingap Pangarap ng Mga Paslit Center, Inc. during a ceremonial check turnover at the PCSO Batangas Branch Office on December 15, 2025. item.title: PCSO Turns Over ₱34.15-M in Mandatory Contributions to PSC, CHED, DDB
item.description: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) reinforced its support to national development by turning over ₱34,153,865.03 in mandatory contributions to the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC), Commission on Higher Education (CHED), and the Dangerous Drugs Board (DDB) during a ceremonial turnover held on December 15, 2025, at the PCSO Main Office. The post PCSO Turns Over ₱34.15-M in Mandatory Contributions to PSC, CHED, DDB first appeared on Fastbreak.

item.title: PCSO turns over grant for newest Institutional partner in Mindanao
item.description: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) further strengthened its commitment to inclusive education and social welfare as it formally turned over a ₱485,000 grant to its newest institutional Partner, the Community of Hope Special Education Center (COHSEC), on December 12, 2025, at the premises of the beneficiary institution in Mindanao.
